Did you know you can change the music that is playing by pressing 'M' on the keyboard?
Did you know that you can save macros by pressing SHIFT + [0 ... 9]  while selecting the units you want to save in the macro?
Did you know you can recall a macro by pressing [0 ... 9]?
Did you know you can copy an object's attributes in the editor by pressig left CTRL while hovering over it with the corresponding tool selected?

[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Triggers, Titles & Undeads
notes.notes:
This patch took quite a lot longer than i would have hoped, but it's one of the biggest and final steps towards the final release, so i'm pretty happy with the results!

Here's what changed:

[list]
[*] Completely remade the triggers system. It is now a lot more powerful and versatile than before.
[*] Added Text "triggers", they do nothing and don't interact with units, they just show text.
[*] Rebuilt the tutorial map using the new Triggers system.
[*] Added Map Title and Subtitle, big text that appears at the start of a map.
[*] Added Map options to the editor, lets you change the title and the subtitle of the map.
[*] Added the Undead soldier, a weak barbarian melee type unit that slowly regenerates hp
[*] Added the Necromancer, a powerful barbarian unit that can harvest the souls of enemy fallen units to create undead soldiers.
[*] Added the Undead Colossus, a very strong melee barbarian unit that loses hp over time, unless it kills something.
[*] Added the Occult Temple, a barbarian building that spawns Necromancers and Undead colossuses.
[*] Added the Oracle stone, the laboratory for the Barbarians.
[*] Added the Necromancy ability to hero active abilites.
[*] Explosions now shake the screen.
[*] Added a visual representation of the researched upgrades.
[*] Added the possibility to kill your own units / destroy your own buildings by pressing Delete while hovering on an unit/building
[*] Optimized ability system.
[*] Changed some ability descriptions.
[*] Added a new Hero weapon, the Great hammer.
[*] Slightly increased the Train time for the Royal Academy.
[*] Added 2 new tiles: Blue and Red.
[*] Added 2 new songs to the soundtrack.
[*] Added  coordinates of the cursor on top of the minimap in the level editor.
[*] The colors of ingame menus are now less Eye-hurting.
[*] Slight performance optimizations.
[*] Editor performance improvements.
[*] Bugfixes.
[/list]

Enjoy and take care!
Stay tuned for more updates SOON™ !

notes.title: Developement update #0
notes.notes:
What's coming in the next update and how far in developement is it? Find out in this post!

[b]First, let's start with what's coming:[/b]

[list]
[*] [b] The new AI, named Skynet, will replace the old AI[/b], named Logan, improving not only in intelligence and capabilities, but also in performance, using less resources overall.
[*]The [b]new achievements[/b] added yesterday will start to work in the next update.
[*] [b]New map generation options. [/b]
[*] Bugfixes and performance improvements
[/list]

How are things going?
- The new AI is pretty much done, it just needs some testing and a few more tactics.
- The new achievements still need to be implemented, but the needed statistics are already being traced in the lastest build.
- The map generation options haven't been started yet, but for how i implemented the map generation (in a modular fashion), it shouldn't take too long
- All the known bugs have been fixed, the fog of war is also coming to the multiplayer.

So that's all folks, I hope you have enjoyed the game so far and that you'll keep enjoying it!

Thanks for reading!
